verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API reference material and building blocks: a downloadable OpenAPI spec, endpoint descriptions in llms-full.txt, SDK code snippets, and links to an /api/checkouts/create reference page. Nothing documents an interactive explorer or a try-it console where examples can be run from the reference. A static reference and a raw spec are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
